title: 第25章 狂血的正确打开方式求追读第26章 历史性时刻汲取生铁特性
slug: 幕后黑手我的词条邪到发癫
content_zh:
抵至焚化厂。
打卡，签到。
早上一具厄尸都没有，人尸也无。
没能收到张桐的尸体，很正常，帮派通常拥有自己的一套处理尸体的流程。
没有工作，冯睦无限制摸鱼，操锻体操。
“错觉吗，比平时消化要快。”
冯睦打锻体操的间隙中，往嘴里塞铁珠的频率比昨天快了亿点点。
[食铁者：一阶]
[可食用铁类：1]
[可汲取金属特性：1]
[当前检测食用铁类——普通生铁，食用度39.7%。]
[已汲取特性：？？]
早上才刚连几遍，食用度已经上涨1个点了。
视网膜上[食用度↑↑]，两个向上的箭头在闪烁。
“平时1个小时，能消化并补充0.5%的食用度，今天同样时间，增长了1%，所以今天是双倍消化速率？”
冯睦很轻易得出数学结论。
“不可能平白获得双倍经验卡，所以，只可能是…….”
冯睦攥了攥拳，袖口纱布下遮蔽的伤口被牵拉，又渗出点殷红的颜色。
冯睦醒悟然后狂喜：“[狂血]的加成，不是只能作用在战斗过程中，在修炼日常里也能起效果？！！”
冯睦的伤口虽然已经止血处理，但丢失的血量，还未补回来。

他又没有找血袋子回血，自身的造血功能也没有那么快，于是，[狂血]依旧在持续作用中。
[狂血]：你的全属性会随着血量流失而成倍加强，如果你的初始属性足够高，那丝血的你，或可反杀神明。
冯睦点开[狂血]的技能介绍，在心底默默诵读三遍。
“全属性成倍加强，的确没有非得限定在战斗中啊，日常修炼的一环，也算全属性范围喽？”
“算啊，当然得算，凭什么不算呢！”
“mmp，都怪最后那句丝血反杀神明的评语，严重误导了我的判断啊~”
冯睦心脏扑通扑通狂跳，他终于明白[狂血]真正正确的打开方式，未必是战斗中反杀敌人，而是日常养成…..我自己。
没有人能天天战斗厮杀，武疯子也不行；
但日常必须伴随每个人，武疯子也逃不脱。
“[狂血]评语误我啊，否则，我现在可能已经练满一阶食用度了，甚至严重溢出也说不定。”
冯睦一想到这十天，满血状态的1倍速修炼，就觉得自己血妈亏，底裤都不想穿了。
是啊，谁能想到，[狂血]不光和[盛宴]是孪生兄妹，还跟[食铁者]有染，这俩搞双修。
“行吧，从今天起也不迟。”冯睦狠狠咬牙激励自己，“我要把落下的进度都补回来，今天不肝到50%的食用度，绝不睡觉。”
1个小时过去。
两个小时过去。
3个小时过去。
中午饭点时间到了。
冯睦恋恋不舍的停下修炼，[当前食用度42.7！]。
这次凉意侵袭了左腿根，左大腿的肌肉被变粗的骨骼撑胀一圈，虽然还差点，才能完全赶上右腿。
但走起路来，已然瞅不出跛脚，重心重回小弟弟的中轴线上。

左腿泛凉，右腿泛凉，闷热的焚化炉内，小弟弟却好像置身冰窖内，冷静的没有一丝欲望和杂念。
食铁者又一隐性福利——禁涩涩，心中无女人。
content_en:
Arrive at the incineration plant.
Check in, sign in.
There was not a single evil corpse in the morning, not even a human corpse.
It was normal that Zhang Tong's body was not received. Gangs usually have their own procedures for disposing of corpses.
Without a job, Feng Mu fished and did gymnastics without any restrictions.
"Is it an illusion? It digests faster than usual."
During Feng Mu's breaks from doing gymnastics, he stuffed iron beads into his mouth a billion times faster than yesterday.
[Iron Eater: Level 1]
[Edible iron: 1]
[Extractable metal properties: 1]
[Currently tested edible iron - ordinary pig iron, with an edible content of 39.7%. ]
[Characteristics learned:? ? ]
I just tried it a few times in the morning, and the food level has already increased by 1 point.
On the retina [edibility ↑↑], two upward arrows are flashing.
"Normally, one hour can digest and replenish 0.5% of the food content. At the same time today, it increased by 1%, so today's digestion rate is doubled?"
Feng Mu came to mathematical conclusions easily.
"It's impossible to get double experience cards for nothing, so it can only be..."
Feng Mu clenched his fists, and the wound covered by the gauze on his cuffs was stretched, and a bright red color oozed out.
Feng Mu came to his senses and was ecstatic: "The [Crazy Blood] bonus can only be used during combat, but it can also be effective during daily practice?!"
Although Feng Mu's wound has been treated to stop bleeding, the lost blood has not yet been replenished.
He did not find a blood bag to restore blood, and his own hematopoietic function was not that fast, so the [Crazy Blood] was still in effect.
[Blood Madness]: All your attributes will be doubled as your blood volume is lost. If your initial attributes are high enough, you may be able to kill the gods with your blood.
Feng Mu clicked on the skill introduction of [Crazy Blood] and read it silently three times in his heart.
"All attributes are multiplied and strengthened. It does not have to be limited to combat. A part of daily practice can also be regarded as the full range of attributes?"
"Forget it, of course it has to be counted, why shouldn't it be counted!"
"Mmp, it's all because of the last comment about killing the gods with blood, which seriously misled my judgment~"
Feng Mu's heart was beating wildly. He finally understood that the true and correct way to open [Crazy Blood] is not necessarily to kill the enemy in battle, but to cultivate it in daily life... myself.
No one can fight and kill every day, not even crazy people;
But it must accompany everyone in daily life, and Wu Madman cannot escape.
"My [Crazy Blood] comment was wrong. Otherwise, I might have reached the first level of food consumption by now, and it might even overflow seriously."
When Feng Mu thought about these ten days of practicing at 1x speed with full blood, he felt that he was so bloodless that he didn't even want to wear underwear.
Yes, who would have thought that [Crazy Blood] is not only twin brother and sister with [Feast], but also has an affair with [Iron Eater]. The two are engaged in dual cultivation.
"Okay, it's not too late to start today." Feng Mu gritted his teeth and encouraged himself, "I want to make up for all the lost progress. I will not sleep until I reach 50% of the food consumption today."
1 hour passed.
Two hours passed.
3 hours passed.
It's lunch time.
Feng Mu reluctantly stopped practicing, [Current consumption level 42.7! ].
This time the coolness invaded the root of the left leg, and the muscles of the left thigh were swollen by the thickened bones. Although it was still not close to fully catching up with the right leg.
But when he walked, his limp was no longer visible, and his focus returned to the central axis of his little brother.
His left leg was cold, his right leg was cold, and in the sweltering incinerator, the little brother seemed to be in an ice cellar, calm without any desire or distracting thoughts.
Another hidden benefit for those who eat iron is that they are forbidden to be astringent and have no women in their hearts.
